name: @treaty-tools/affected
description: Nx/Turborepo-style 'affected' at federated-module granularity. Given a changed-file list (e.g. `git diff --name-only`) and a project dependency graph (federated modules, lazy routes-as-remotes, libs), compute the affected set = the directly-changed modules PLUS their transitive dependents, so CI compiles/tests/deploys only that federation. A standalone, dependency-free tool isolated from the main workspace.
author: Jordan Hall

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
